products.summary: A MagSafe-style selfie stick that turns into a full-height tripod when you tap its base on the ground, with a small rechargeable Bluetooth remote that clips to the pole. Digital Camera World puts it first for MagSafe phones.
products.renterNote: iPhone (or MagSafe-case) vloggers who want one stick for handheld, standing-height and overhead shots. Key caveat: reviewers report wobble at full extension, and non-MagSafe phones need the adhesive ring.
pros: Legs open by tapping the base on a surface, so setup takes seconds
Strong magnetic mount with 180 degree tilt and 360 degree rotation
Bluetooth remote is USB-C rechargeable and docks magnetically on the pole
cons: Wobbles noticeably at full 66 in extension (Macworld) and folding the legs back can be fiddly
Built around MagSafe; other phones need the adhesive metal ring and there is no screw mount for small cameras
facts: Pole runs 13 in collapsed to 66 in extended (B&H and KraftGeek listings)
